QuestInfo.name: Rudolph, All Grown Up?
QuestInfo.0: Rudolph is growing up, and he ran away from home! Help Maple Claws get Rebellious Rudolph back.
QuestInfo.1: Rebellious Rudolph is showing up in random places. Find him, rough him up a little, then report back to Maple Claws.
QuestInfo.2: Rudolph got his act together and went home. To thank you, Maple Claws gave you a gift.

0.0: Oh my oh my oh my! I need to deliver my presents soon, but Rudolph ran away! He's been acting up lately. I guess he's growing up... But he's still my reindeer, and he's got a job to do! Do you mind giving him a few smarks from me?

yes.0: There's no telling where that sneaky reindeer ran off to. If you run into him while hunting, feel free to knock some sense into him!

no.0: How'm I supposed to deliver my presents without him? Think of the children!

mob.0: If you ever run into Rudolph, knock some sense into him!

yes.0: Thanks! Rudolph came back and apologized for acting up. Here, take this gift.
